projects.name: Analytics Dashboard Platform
projects.description:
End-to-end analytics dashboard: ingest and process customer CSV files, analyze application logs, and surface everything through reusable visualization components. Structured as five milestones (Foundation, Customer Data Processing, Log Analysis, Visualization, Integration & Launch), each decomposed into execution-sized tasks with explicit cross-milestone dependencies.

Tags: analytics, dashboard, data-processing, log-analysis, visualization

tasks.name: M1: Foundation and Architecture
tasks.details: Establish the analytical questions the dashboard must answer, define the technical architecture for CSV and log pipelines, and stand up the repo/toolchain that the rest of the work builds on. Unblocks all other milestones.

tasks.name: M2: Customer CSV Data Processing
tasks.details: Ingest customer CSV exports, validate and normalise them, land them in a queryable store, and produce the customer metrics the dashboard charts will consume.

tasks.name: M3: Application Log Analysis
tasks.details: Collect and parse application logs, enrich and classify them, aggregate into metrics, and add anomaly/alerting rules so the dashboard can show system health alongside customer data.

tasks.name: M4: Visualization Components
tasks.details: Build a reusable component library, then the customer and log chart surfaces on top of it, and assemble them into a navigable dashboard with shared filters.

tasks.name: M5: Integration, Testing and Launch
tasks.details: Validate the assembled dashboard end to end against realistic data volumes, harden performance, document and hand over, then deploy to production with monitoring.

tasks.name: Define dashboard requirements and KPI catalogue
tasks.details: Interview stakeholders, list the customer and operational questions the dashboard must answer, and produce a single KPI catalogue with definition, formula, source (CSV field or log field) and acceptable freshness for each metric. Deliverable: KPI catalogue doc agreed by stakeholders. Explicitly out of scope: architecture choices and tooling.

tasks.name: Design system architecture and data flow
tasks.details: Translate the KPI catalogue into a component-level architecture: batch CSV ingestion path, log ingestion path, storage/query layer, metrics/aggregation layer, API layer, and frontend. Produce a data-flow diagram and a short decision record covering storage engine and refresh cadence. Deliverable: one architecture document plus ADRs; no code.

tasks.name: Set up repository, toolchain and CI pipeline
tasks.details: Create the monorepo (pipeline service, dashboard app, shared schema package), configure linting/formatting, local dev environment with docker-compose, and a CI pipeline that runs lint, type-check and unit tests on every PR. Deliverable: green CI on an empty skeleton commit.

tasks.name: Implement CSV ingestion with schema validation
tasks.details: Build the upload/pickup job that reads customer CSV files, detects encoding and delimiter, validates headers and row types against the declared schema, and quarantines bad rows with actionable error messages. Includes unit tests for malformed, empty and oversized files. Deliverable: ingestion command/scheduled job writing validated data to a landing area.

tasks.name: Build data cleaning and normalisation pipeline
tasks.details: Implement deterministic cleaning steps on validated CSV rows: trim and canonicalise strings, normalise dates to UTC ISO-8601, parse currency and numeric formats, standardise country/plan codes, deduplicate on customer ID and derive a stable surrogate key. Deliverable: transformations with before/after fixtures proving idempotency.

tasks.name: Create customer warehouse schema and load process
tasks.details: Design the customer dimension and fact tables in the chosen store, write the idempotent load (upsert on surrogate key) with run metadata, and add basic data-quality checks (row-count reconciliation, null checks on required fields). Deliverable: migration scripts plus a verified load of a sample CSV export.

tasks.name: Implement customer metrics aggregation jobs
tasks.details: Turn the warehouse tables into the KPI aggregates from the catalogue: active customers, new vs churned, revenue per plan/region, and cohort retention. Each metric gets a scheduled job, a documented grain and a golden-dataset test asserting known expected values. Deliverable: metric tables queryable per dashboard filter dimension.

tasks.name: Implement log collection and parsing
tasks.details: Ship or configure a collector that tails application log files/streams, handles rotation and multi-line stack traces, and parses them into structured records (timestamp, level, service, request ID, message, stack). Include a parser test suite covering each known log format variant. Deliverable: parsed records landing in raw storage with a documented schema.

tasks.name: Build log enrichment and error classification
tasks.details: Enrich parsed records with service/environment metadata, extract latency and HTTP status where present, and map free-text errors onto a fixed error taxonomy plus severity. Deliverable: enriched records with a documented classification table and tests covering the top error signatures found in production logs.

tasks.name: Aggregate logs into a metrics time-series store
tasks.details: Build scheduled rollups over enriched logs at 1-minute and 1-hour grains: error rate by service, p50/p95/p99 latency, request volume, and top error signatures. Denormalise into the dimensions the dashboard filters on and set a documented retention policy. Deliverable: queryable time-series tables validated against a hand-computed sample window.

tasks.name: Add anomaly detection thresholds and alert rules
tasks.details: Define static and baseline-relative thresholds on the log metrics (error-rate spike, latency regression, log-volume drop) and implement them as evaluable rules that record state transitions. Deliverable: rule definitions plus a back-test against historical data showing precision/recall of fired alerts, ready for the dashboard health panel.

tasks.name: Create design tokens and shared component library
tasks.details: Establish the visual foundation: colour/typography/spacing tokens, accessible chart palette, and base components (Card, KPI tile, Legend, Tooltip, EmptyState, LoadingSkeleton, ErrorState). Deliverable: a documented component library with a storybook-style showcase and accessibility checks.

tasks.name: Build customer analytics chart components
tasks.details: Implement the customer-side visualisations against the metrics API: KPI tiles, revenue trend line, plan/region breakdown, and cohort retention heatmap. Each chart handles loading, empty and error states. Deliverable: chart components rendered from live metric endpoints with a screenshot-based visual test.

tasks.name: Build application health and log analysis views
tasks.details: Implement the operational surface: error-rate time series by service, latency percentile chart, top-error leaderboard, and an active-alerts panel, all with drill-down to a filtered log excerpt. Deliverable: health views wired to the log metrics API with loading/empty/error states and visual tests.

tasks.name: Build dashboard layout, routing and responsive shell
tasks.details: Create the application shell only: page layout, route definitions for the customer and health views, primary navigation, and responsive breakpoints. Charts are mounted into placeholder slots. Deliverable: every route renders with placeholders at desktop, tablet and mobile widths. Filters and data caching are handled by a separate follow-on task.

tasks.name: Implement dashboard query API over customer and log metrics
tasks.details: Expose read-only endpoints over the customer metric tables and the log time-series: one endpoint per chart shape, consistent filter parameters (date range, segment, service), server-side pagination for log excerpts, and response caching with a short TTL. Deliverable: OpenAPI spec plus contract tests asserting response shapes the frontend expects.

tasks.name: Run end-to-end integration tests on realistic datasets
tasks.details: Assemble a representative dataset (multi-month customer CSVs plus one week of real log samples) and drive the full path: ingest, transform, load, aggregate, API, dashboard. Assert every KPI on screen matches hand-computed expected values and that failure paths (bad CSV, empty log window) degrade gracefully. Deliverable: automated E2E suite in CI plus a signed-off test report.

tasks.name: Performance and load testing of pipeline and dashboard
tasks.details: Define target volumes and latency budgets from the architecture doc, then measure: CSV ingest throughput and memory ceiling, aggregation job runtime, API p95 latency under concurrent load, and dashboard first-paint on a throttled connection. Fix or document every budget breach. Deliverable: load-test scripts plus a results table against agreed budgets.

tasks.name: Write operator documentation and run handover session
tasks.details: Document how to onboard a new CSV source, add a log format, change a threshold, and troubleshoot a failed pipeline run; record the KPI definitions alongside the code that computes them. Deliverable: README plus runbook, and a recorded handover walkthrough with the on-call owner.

tasks.name: Deploy to production with monitoring and rollback plan
tasks.details: Provision production infrastructure, run migrations, deploy the pipeline and dashboard, and wire monitoring: pipeline run success/failure, data freshness per source, API error rate and latency, plus dashboard error tracking. Include a rehearsed rollback step and a post-deploy smoke check. Deliverable: live dashboard with alerting on pipeline staleness.

tasks.name: Implement global filters and query caching layer
tasks.details: Add the shared date-range and segment filters held in the URL so views are shareable, plus the query/caching layer that dedupes and reuses in-flight requests so one filter change updates every panel without redundant fetches. Deliverable: changing a filter once updates all panels consistently, with a test proving no duplicate requests fire.
